name: Goliath
traits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid with a 30-ft. base land speed. +4 Strength, −2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution. Proficient with simple weapons through the species. Armor and shield proficiency come from other sources, such as class.
Darkvision 60 ft. comes from the Monstrous Humanoid type, as confirmed by the official 3.5 FAQ.

Powerful Build treats a Goliath as one size larger when that helps an opposed check with a size modifier, such as grapple, bull rush, or trip. Treat it as one size larger against size-dependent special attacks such as improved grab or swallow whole.

Powerful Build also allows weapons designed for creatures one size larger without an inappropriate-size penalty. Space, reach, and natural or unarmed damage use actual size. It stacks with size changes that preserve the trait.

Mountain Movement allows standing long jumps and high jumps using the running Jump rules. Accelerated climbing moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 Climb penalty. Climb checks still apply.
Acclimated removes the altitude penalties under Mountain Travel in the Dungeon Master’s Guide, p. 90. Acclimation persists after time at low elevation.
+2 bonus on Sense Motive checks. Common and Gol-Kaa are automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarven, Giant, Gnoll, and Terran.
Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +1. The playable entry grants no racial Hit Dice.

Optional Barbarian substitution at class level 1 replaces ordinary rage with Mountain Rage. It makes the Goliath Large, adds +2 Strength beyond ordinary rage, and gives 10-ft. space and reach and an extra −1 to AC and attacks. The substitution keeps equipment fitting and explicitly gives no additional weapon-size or grapple benefit from Powerful Build.
